answer_1.quote: In this paper, we present the first study to impose free-form controllable persona on story generation. Specifically, we require generation models to generate a coherent story, where the protagonist should exhibit the desired personality.

answer_2.quote: We adopt the following automatic metrics for evaluation on the test set. (1) BLEU ... (2) BERTScore-target (BS-t): ... (3) BERTScore-max (BS-m): ... (4) Persona-Consistency (PC): ...

answer_4.quote: We conduct a pairwise comparison between our model and four strong baselines... we hire three annotators to give a preference (win, lose or tie) in terms of coherence ... and persona-consistency ... Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) for the annotation. ... We hired three graduates to judge whether each story accords with the input persona.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to compare two generated stories on two dimensions: coherence (intersentence relatedness, causal and temporal dependencies) and persona-consistency with the given persona description, using majority voting to decide the final judgment.
